pick.name: Udyam (MSME) registration
pick.what: Free MSME registration (Aadhaar; PAN + GSTIN pulled automatically)
pick.why: Free, works for a sole proprietor today, MSME protections (delayed-payment rules); after incorporating, it keeps the company on the Rs 4,500 'small enterprise' trademark rate (a sole proprietor already gets it as an individual)
pick.free_limits: Totally free; one registration per enterprise; micro = investment <= Rs 2.5 cr and turnover <= Rs 10 cr (from 1 Apr 2025)

alts.name: DPIIT Startup India recognition
alts.why: Unlocks 80-IAC 3-year tax holiday (Pvt Ltd/LLP only), self-certification, procurement relaxations
alts.free_limits: Eligible: Pvt Ltd, partnership, LLP, co-op; <10 yrs old (20 for DeepTech); turnover < Rs 200 cr (Rs 300 cr DeepTech). Sole prop and OPC are not eligible

decision: Register on Udyam now (free, 10 minutes). Apply for DPIIT recognition only after incorporating a Pvt Ltd/LLP, because sole proprietors and OPCs are excluded. 80-IAC still needs a separate application to the inter-ministerial board.
details: GSTIN is required only where GST registration applies (portal: 'subject to CGST Act applicability'), so GST-exempt proprietors register with Aadhaar + PAN.

verify.note: Udyam is free, with micro <= Rs 2.5 cr investment / Rs 10 cr turnover from 1 Apr 2025 (confirmed). GSTIN is needed only 'subject to CGST Act applicability', which resolves the note. But the 'why' overstates Udyam's trademark benefit: a sole proprietor filing in their own name already pays the individual rate of Rs 4,500. Udyam matters for the TM fee only once a company files.
